Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning the possession and capture of birds of prey.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to falconry; adding a new section to chapter 77.32RCW; and adding a new section to chapter 77.15 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 77.32 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The director shall adopt fees for the issuance and monitoring ofpermits issued by the department for the purpose of falconry, taking ofa wild raptor, captive live propagation, and for the possession,transfer, use, and disposition of raptors. The falconry permit isvalid for two years and the permit fee is one hundred dollars forresidents and five hundred dollars for nonresidents. Fees may not becollected in any period when the United States fish and wildlifeservice charges a fee for the issuance of a substantially similarpermit. The fees may not be imposed before the current fees charged bysuch federal agency are discontinued.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 77.15 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Nothing in RCW 77.15.194 prohibits the use of body gripping trapsfor the capturing of live raptors for falconry authorized under afalconry permit issued by the director.
